THERAILGUN2-COIN_RELIC.title: Collector's Coin
THERAILGUN2-COIN_RELIC.description: If you end your turn with unspent {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{Lightning}[/blue] [gold]Lightning[/gold] for each {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} unspent, up to {Repeat:diff()} times.
THERAILGUN2-COIN_RELIC2.title: Collector's Coin Pro
THERAILGUN2-COIN_RELIC2.description:
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} at the start of each turn.
If you end your turn with unspent {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)}, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{Lightning}[/blue] [gold]Lightning[/gold] for each {energyPrefix:energyIcons(1)} unspent, up to {Repeat:diff()} times.

THERAILGUN2-DATA_DISK_RAILGUN.descriptio: At the start of each combat, apply [blue]{VulnerablePower}[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to ALL enemies.
THERAILGUN2-DATA_DISK_RAILGUN.flavor: [red]Details for this relic will be revealed in the future...[/red]
THERAILGUN2-SPARE_CORE.title: Spare Core
THERAILGUN2-SPARE_CORE.description: At the start of each combat, [gold]Channel[/gold] [blue]{Repeat}[/blue] [gold]Lightning[/gold].
THERAILGUN2-SPARE_CORE.flavor: The mysterious life force which powers the Automatons within the Spire. It appears to be cracked.
THERAILGUN2-LOCK_ON_PAPER_PHROG.title: Lock-On Paper Phrog
THERAILGUN2-LOCK_ON_PAPER_PHROG.descript: Enemies with [gold]Lock-On[/gold] take [blue]75%[/blue] more damage rather than [blue]50%[/blue].
THERAILGUN2-LOCK_ON_PAPER_PHROG.flavor: The paper continually folds and unfolds itself into the shape of frog!
